methods.summary: Only the price-flow part is testable: 100-day MA, re-picked every 2 weeks 17.0%/yr (Sharpe 0.60, -46% worst drop) vs SPY 13.7% (0.75); an isolated best setting. Fundamental fingerprints, insider signal and theme map untested.
